publication.title: [v0.91.7][WP-19] Retain final external review findings
publication.body:
Closes #4646

Retains the completed exact-target WP-19 review over 70 files and its 22 findings. One Claude Fable 5 lane completed; three independent shadow reviewers covered the remaining files after Anthropic billing blocked further calls. The provider-degradation boundary and WP-20 ownership are explicit.
